editorial:
Picture this: it's the last day of school, and one teacher accidentally gets another teacher fired. That's the setup for Fist Fight, a comedy that turns a simple misunderstanding into an all-out war. Charlie Day plays Andy Campbell, a mild-mannered English teacher who just wants to keep his job and make it home to his pregnant wife. Ice Cube plays Ron Strickland, a no-nonsense history teacher who challenges Andy to an after-school fight after getting fired. The whole movie builds up to that one big showdown, and the tension is played for laughs the entire way through. The vibe is loud, silly, and packed with energy, kind of like a grown-up version of a schoolyard dare.

Standout moments come from the supporting cast. Jillian Bell steals scenes as a wildly inappropriate guidance counselor, and Tracy Morgan brings his usual charm as the gym teacher. The fight itself is surprisingly well done and gets some real laughs. On the downside, the humor can be hit or miss, and some jokes feel a bit forced. If you enjoy silly comedies with big personalities, this one is a fun pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the big fight finally happens in the school parking lot. Andy actually holds his own and the fight goes viral online. Instead of getting in trouble, the viral video brings attention to the school's problems and leads to more funding. Andy and Strickland make peace, and Andy earns respect from students and staff. The movie ends on a lighter note with the teachers getting along better.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly comedies with big personalities.
